L: In local news, the Elm Street Bridge will close for repairs starting next Monday.
City engineers say the work is needed to strengthen the bridge's supports, which are more than sixty years old.
The repairs are expected to take about three weeks.
During that time, drivers are advised to use the Harbor Road Bridge instead.
To help reduce traffic, the city will add extra buses on Route 9 during the morning and evening rush hours.
For updates, residents can visit the city's Web site.
